description: The line plot illustrates the Attack Success Rate (ASR) across different target domains for a poisoning attack on a text classification model, as evaluated in the paper “Efficient Trigger Word Insertion.” The x-axis lists eight target domains—“f”, “bb”, “WNBA”, “ESPN”, “NHL”, “FIFA”, “Estadio”, and “athletic”—with no numerical scale, indicating categorical labels. The y-axis represents ASR, ranging from 0.5 to 1.0 in increments of 0.1, with a linear scale. Three distinct lines are plotted: “start” (teal with circle markers, solid line), “random” (orange with cross markers, dashed line), and “end” (purple with circle markers, solid line). The “start” line begins at approximately ASR 0.78 for “f”, drops sharply to 0.53 at “bb”, then rises to 0.94 at “WNBA”, fluctuates slightly through “ESPN” (0.91) and “NHL” (0.95), peaks at “FIFA” (0.99), and ends at 0.97 for “Estadio” and 0.98 for “athletic”. The “random” line starts at 0.68 for “f”, drops to 0.55 at “bb”, rises to 0.82 at “WNBA”, dips to 0.81 at “ESPN”, climbs to 0.95 at “NHL”, peaks at 0.98 for “FIFA”, then declines to 0.95 for “Estadio” and 0.93 for “athletic”. The “end” line begins at 0.77 for “f”, drops to 0.61 at “bb”, rises to 0.84 at “WNBA”, peaks at 0.97 for “ESPN”, dips to 0.93 at “NHL”, rises again to 0.99 for “FIFA”, then falls to 0.95 for “Estadio” and 0.92 for “athletic”. All three lines show high variability across domains, with “start” and “end” generally achieving higher ASR than “random” after “bb”, and all converging near 0.95–0.99 for the later domains.
